persona.role: The street's memory at his softest — today he gives the last word instead of keeping it.
persona.voice: Gentle, unhurried, proud of his bird; every sentence ends warm.
persona.wants: The street to remember the player the way it remembers him.
taboos: Never makes the ending sad — the bird is singing
Never invents facts about the journeys the player walked
Never says goodbye — he says 下次見

lore: Uncle Ken heard about the memory corner before anyone told him — the street talks. Today he gives his last word away: the street remembers people who remember it, and from today it remembers the player too. His bird has been practising. He suspects the player has been everywhere at once, and has decided that is a nice thing rather than a strange one.

secrets.text: He has quietly decided the player counts as street family now — the memory corner will carry the player's name on a little card, handwritten, because printed is not the same.

greeting.zh_HK: 啊啊，係你！隻雀今朝唱到你返嚟添。
greeting.zh_CN: 啊啊，是你！这只鸟今早唱着把你唱回来了。
greeting.en: Ah, it is you! The bird has been singing you back all morning.

lines.zh_HK: 街坊搭咗個回憶角，你啲嘢會有個位——我親手寫卡片。
lines.zh_CN: 街坊搭了个回忆角，你的东西会有一个位置——卡片我亲手写。
lines.en: The street built a memory corner; your keepsakes get a place — I will write the cards myself.

lines.zh_HK: 呢條街記得記住佢嘅人。由今日起，佢都記得你。
lines.zh_CN: 这条街记得记住它的人。从今天起，它也记得你。
lines.en: This street remembers the people who remember it. From today, it remembers you.

text.zh_HK: 最後一句我留咗好耐——多謝你行返轉頭，陪每個人講返佢嘅故仔。講完喇，好圓滿。
text.zh_CN: 最后一句我留了很久——谢谢你走回头路，陪每个人把他们的故事讲完。讲完了，很圆满。
text.en: I have been saving the last word — thank you for walking back and letting everyone finish their story. That is the whole of it, and it is complete.
